actions: Read final docs/EXPORT_READER.md, example README, CI workflow, owner-checks.json, entire reproduce.py and receipt.py.
Inspect test harness isolated fixture-module loading, oracle override/default, hash pin and child interpreter argv, stdout/err bounds, CLI entrypoints and standard-library import boundary.
Run python3 -I -S -B -Werror examples/independent-export-reader-v1/receipt.py --check: exit0, PASS; receipt source and retained observations match.
AST syntax parse all reviewed Python source without compilation/cache writes.

assessment.oracle_portability: --oracle accepts explicit Path and remains hash-pinned; default resolves repository-local evidence relative to resolved script path. No temporary development path dependency.
assessment.isolated_imports: Test fixture loaded explicitly by absolute source path; -I -S does not remove required sibling module lookup because ordinary import lookup is not used. Reader itself standard library only.
assessment.replay: Reproduce copies standalone reader plus export and separately compares source originals/text/metadata. Child -I -S -B argv requires no native/producer package. Filesystem arrangement is explicitly not hostile isolation.
assessment.claims: Docs and receipt retain TESTED/UNPROVEN and NOT_PERFORMED boundaries; exact exported bytes do not assert semantic fidelity, authenticity, human validation or whole-system proof.
assessment.output_bounds: Reader bounds were reviewed earlier; replay child FSIZE and bounded reads/writes constrain retained output. Receipt bounded inventory and byte limits apply to trusted release-tree inputs.
assessment.scope: Suitable for new-file development checkpoint only; no merge/tag/product-release acceptance inferred.

limitations: No normal/optimized campaign rerun; owner observations read and source-bound receipt checked, not independently regenerated.
GitHub workflow not remotely executed in this review; Python 3.14.10 setup availability and hosted runner behavior remain CI evidence requirements.
Receipt and replay harnesses consume trusted release fixtures, not adversarial filesystem trees.
Not external organization or human validation; no whole-system proof.
smallest_sound_next_step: Publish only the authorized source-bound checkpoint with these receipts; obtain actual hosted CI outcome before claiming that workflow passes.
